sections.title: 1. Business Information
sections.content: Lux Customs is a South East Melbourne-based automotive window tinting and vehicle protection business located at Springvale, Victoria 3802. Our services may include car tinting, ceramic paint protection, graphene coating, dash cam installation, old tint removal, and other related vehicle protection services.

sections.title: 2. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing our website, submitting an enquiry, accepting a quote, booking an appointment, or allowing us to perform work on your vehicle, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted these Terms. If you are booking on behalf of another person, business, or organisation, you confirm that you have authority to accept these Terms on their behalf.

sections.title: 3. Use of Our Website
sections.content: You agree to use our website for lawful purposes only. You must not misuse the website, attempt to interfere with its security, submit false information, copy website content without permission, or use the website in a way that may damage Lux Customs or its users. The information on our website is provided for general guidance only.

sections.title: 4. Quotes and Pricing
sections.content: Any quote provided by Lux Customs is based on the information available at the time, including the vehicle type, service requested, condition of the vehicle, and any customer requirements. Quotes may change if the vehicle condition is different from what was described, additional preparation is required, old tint is harder to remove than expected, or extra work is requested.

sections.title: 5. Bookings and Appointments
sections.content: Bookings are subject to availability. We may require your name, contact details, vehicle details, selected service, and preferred appointment time to confirm a booking. You are responsible for arriving on time and ensuring the vehicle is available for the agreed service. Lux Customs may reschedule a booking due to unforeseen circumstances, staff availability, product supply issues, or safety concerns.

sections.title: 6. Customer Responsibilities
sections.content: Before your appointment, you must remove personal belongings, valuables, loose items, child seats where required, and any items that may affect access to the vehicle. You must tell us about any existing vehicle damage, electrical issues, aftermarket modifications, previous tinting, paint defects, glass damage, or other issues that may affect the service.

sections.title: 7. Vehicle Condition and Existing Damage
sections.content: Some services may reveal pre-existing damage, poor previous workmanship, scratches, adhesive residue, paint defects, glass imperfections, trim wear, or other vehicle issues. Lux Customs will take reasonable care when working on your vehicle, but we are not responsible for pre-existing damage, hidden defects, weakened components, or poor previous tinting.

sections.title: 8. Service Results and Limitations
sections.content: We aim to provide high-quality workmanship and professional results. However, final results may vary depending on the age, condition, shape, glass type, paint condition, previous work, and maintenance history of the vehicle. Minor curing effects may occur while window tint settles.

sections.title: 9. Aftercare Instructions
sections.content: You must follow all aftercare instructions provided by Lux Customs. This may include guidance on when to open windows after tinting, how to clean coated surfaces, how to maintain paint protection, or how to use installed equipment. Failure to follow aftercare instructions may affect service results and limit warranty coverage.

sections.title: 10. Payments
sections.content: Payment is due as agreed at the time of booking, quotation, invoice, or completion of work. Lux Customs may require a deposit for certain bookings, products, or services. If payment is not made when due, Lux Customs may withhold release of the vehicle where legally permitted. All prices are in Australian dollars unless otherwise stated.

sections.title: 11. Deposits, Cancellations and Rescheduling
sections.content: If a deposit is required, it will be explained before booking. If you need to cancel or reschedule, please provide reasonable notice. Late cancellations, missed appointments, or repeated rescheduling may result in loss of deposit or booking refusal, where permitted by law.

sections.title: 12. Refunds, Repairs and Consumer Guarantees
sections.content: Our services come with rights and guarantees under Australian Consumer Law that cannot be excluded, restricted, or modified. If there is a problem with a service, please contact Lux Customs as soon as possible and give us a reasonable opportunity to inspect the vehicle and assess the issue.

sections.title: 13. Warranties
sections.content: Any warranty offered by Lux Customs will be explained at the time of service or in written service information. A warranty does not replace your rights under Australian Consumer Law. Warranty claims may require proof of purchase, vehicle inspection, and confirmation that aftercare instructions were followed.

sections.title: 14. Customer-Supplied Products
sections.content: If you ask Lux Customs to install or use a product supplied by you, we may agree at our discretion. We are not responsible for the quality, compatibility, durability, legality, or performance of customer-supplied products.

sections.title: 15. Legal Tinting Requirements
sections.content: Customers are responsible for ensuring their vehicle remains compliant with applicable road laws and tinting requirements. Lux Customs can provide general guidance, but final compliance depends on local regulations. We reserve the right to refuse work that we believe may be unsafe, unlawful, or unsuitable.

sections.title: 16. Photos, Marketing and Reviews
sections.content: Lux Customs may take photos or videos of completed work for quality records, marketing, social media, website content, or portfolio purposes. If you do not want your vehicle photographed or used in marketing, please tell us before the service begins.

sections.title: 17. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All content on the Lux Customs website, including text, images, graphics, logos, service descriptions, layouts, and branding, is owned by or licensed to Lux Customs unless otherwise stated. You must not copy, reproduce, distribute, modify, or use our website content for commercial purposes without written permission.

sections.title: 18. Third-Party Links and Products
sections.content: Our website or communications may include links to third-party websites, platforms, suppliers, or products. Lux Customs is not responsible for the content, accuracy, policies, availability, or performance of third-party websites, products, or services.

sections.title: 19. Privacy
sections.content: Lux Customs may collect personal information such as your name, phone number, email address, vehicle details, booking information, and service history to respond to enquiries, provide services, process payments, and manage bookings in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

sections.title: 20. Disclaimers
sections.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Lux Customs makes no guarantee that our website will always be available, error-free, secure, or free from technical issues. Nothing in these Terms excludes, restricts, or modifies any consumer rights that cannot be excluded under Australian law.

sections.title: 21. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Lux Customs is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential loss. Where liability cannot be excluded, our liability will be limited to the extent permitted by law, which may include re-supplying the service, repairing the issue, or refunding the amount paid.

sections.title: 22. Refusal or Termination of Service
sections.content: Lux Customs may refuse, suspend, or terminate service where a customer provides false information, behaves abusively, fails to pay, requests unsafe or unlawful work, repeatedly misses appointments, or breaches these Terms.

sections.title: 23. Dispute Resolution
sections.content: If you have a concern or complaint, please contact Lux Customs first so we can review the issue and attempt to resolve it promptly. You agree to give us a reasonable opportunity to inspect the vehicle, assess the concern, and propose a fair solution before taking further action.

sections.title: 24. Changes to These Terms
sections.content: Lux Customs may update these Terms and Conditions from time to time. The updated version will be posted on our website with the revised date. Continued use of our website or services after changes are published means you accept the updated Terms.

sections.title: 25. Governing Law
sections.content: These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of Victoria, Australia. Any disputes will be handled in the courts, tribunals, or dispute resolution bodies that have jurisdiction in Victoria, unless otherwise required by law.
